task.objective: Rescue 32 stranded residents while crews choose how to allocate finite basalt among local shelters, causeways and boat capacity.
task.natural_termination: Natural completion occurs exactly when all 32 resident saved flags are true. Otherwise H=896 truncates the ongoing world; no reward target is a release condition.
task.interaction: Nearby bracing enables another actor to take and move a stretcher; finite stone supports communal crossings or private protection; boat cargo displaces passenger capacity and gate state changes physical reachability.
task.observation_access: Actor entities use four nearest rows within L1 radius 6 plus self. Every non-agent group is visible within L1 radius 6. Home shelter/rescue ledger and deterministic clock/tide are known to that crew. There is no remote ash/boat/route state in a role's flat observation.
